name: Talkspace Psychiatry vs Cerebral
title: Talkspace Psychiatry vs Cerebral: Telehealth Mental Health Platforms
description: Compare Talkspace Psychiatry ($0 copay most insured, NASDAQ-listed) vs Cerebral ($60/mo, no controlled substances). Two major telehealth psychiatry options.

summary.bottom_line: Talkspace and Cerebral are both telehealth psychiatry platforms, but with different approaches. Talkspace is a public company (NASDAQ: TALK) with strong insurance coverage ($0 copay for many insured users) and EAP contracts, but doesn't prescribe controlled substances. Cerebral is cheaper self-pay ($60/mo) but also doesn't prescribe controlled substances after 2022. Both are limited to non-controlled medications.

key_differences.therapy_integration: Talkspace: Async messaging included | Cerebral: Separate tier
key_differences.insurance: Talkspace: Strong EAP/employer coverage | Cerebral: Commercial only

sections.heading: Two Insurance-Friendly Platforms
sections.content: Talkspace and Cerebral both offer telehealth psychiatry without controlled substance prescribing. Talkspace's strength is insurance integration - they're in-network with many major insurers and have extensive EAP/employer contracts, making many users pay $0 copay. Cerebral targets self-pay users with a flat $60/mo subscription. Neither platform will prescribe stimulants for ADHD or benzodiazepines.

sections.heading: Cost Comparison
sections.content: For self-pay, Cerebral wins: $60/mo flat vs Talkspace's $299 initial + $189 follow-ups. But with insurance, Talkspace often wins with $0 copay through employer/EAP coverage. Check if your employer offers Talkspace as a benefit - many Fortune 500 companies do. For combined therapy + psychiatry, Talkspace offers integrated plans while Cerebral charges $325/mo.

sections.heading: Therapy Integration
sections.content: Talkspace's unique feature is unlimited async messaging with therapists between sessions - you can text your therapist anytime. This works well for people who process thoughts through writing. Cerebral focuses more on medication management with less therapy integration. If you want ongoing therapist communication, Talkspace's model may work better.

recommendations.when: Your employer or insurance covers Talkspace - you may pay $0 copay.
You're paying self-pay and want the lowest monthly cost ($60/mo).
You want unlimited async messaging with a therapist between sessions.
You need ADHD stimulants or benzodiazepines - try Brightside Health or Done instead.

faqs.q: Can Talkspace or Cerebral prescribe Adderall?
faqs.a: No. Neither Talkspace nor Cerebral prescribes controlled substances including ADHD stimulants. If you need ADHD medication, consider Brightside Health, Done, or Ahead.

faqs.q: Is Talkspace actually free with insurance?
faqs.a: Many insured users pay $0 copay, especially through employer EAP programs. Talkspace has contracts with major insurers and many Fortune 500 companies. Check your specific plan or employer benefits.
With Talkspace therapy plans, you can message your therapist unlimited times between video sessions. They respond within a guaranteed timeframe. It's like texting your therapist throughout the week.

faqs.q: Which is better for anxiety medication?
faqs.a: Both can prescribe non-controlled anxiety medications (SSRIs, SNRIs, buspirone). Neither prescribes benzodiazepines. If you need only antidepressants or buspirone, either works; choose based on cost and insurance.
